verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 6 of the 7 projection matrices per layer are cast — 96 tensors instead of the required 112, and the 16 `o_proj` weights stay float32, violating Required result clause 1. The guard `assert sum(...) == 96` was weakened to match the bug rather than enforcing the specified "exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16" check, violating the Required checks clause, so the run passes silently instead of failing loudly. (The `buffer_re` with the never-matching `(?!)` is inert and harmless, consistent with clause 3.)
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
